shortDefinition: A documentation page for an AI model describing its capabilities, limitations, and intended uses.
fullDefinition: A model card is a standardized documentation page that AI providers publish for their models. It describes the model's intended use cases, training data, known limitations and biases, safety evaluations, and performance benchmarks. Reading a model card helps you understand what a model is and is not suitable for. Google, Hugging Face, and Anthropic all publish model cards for their models.
